Storefront and customer routes of the analytics module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## POST /v1/analytics/events

Ingest a storefront analytics event

Request body: [IngestEventDto](#ingesteventdto).

Responses:

- `204`: no description.

## Schemas

### IngestEventDto

- `eventType` (object, required).
- `sessionId` (string, pattern `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/`, max length 128, optional).
- `userId` (string, optional).
- `productId` (string, optional).
- `orderId` (string, optional).
- `data` (object, optional).
- `locale` (string, optional).
